claims.statement: 1954 총선 자유당 115석은 미국 외교관만의 단독 집계다
claims.conclusion: UN original A/2711 para74 independently gives 115 Liberal, 15 DNP, 67 independent, two minor parties 3 each, sum203. US May24 FRUS editor cites same 115; US editorial note explicitly refers UN A/2711 so US/UN numerical agreement may not be fully independent, but UN report authored separately. NEC later114, NIKH later114 and NIKH table144. Exact classification/temporal source still conflicted.

claims.statement: 1954 선거는 전혀 경찰개입 없이 자유롭게 진행됐다고 UNCURK와 미국대사관이 일치했다
claims.conclusion: UNCURK paras70/75 accepts some interference charges had factual basis and police practice not fully overcome but concludes voting was essentially free; US July14 emphasizes widespread police interference and serious pre-election pressure. Difference is extent/interpretation, not a simple factual yes/no. Neither proves Rhee direct order.

claims.statement: 1954 136 자유당 교섭단체 의석은 5월20일 선거에서 모두 자유당 공천 당선자였다
claims.conclusion: UNCURK para77 says 21 elected independents joined Liberal parliamentary negotiating group to136. Election-party affiliation and later caucus registration must be separated. 115+21=136 as reported; individual accession list open.

claims.statement: 1954 UNKRA 승인 예산 8500만달러는 1954-09-01까지 전액 현물 도착했다
contradicting_evidence: Yearbook 1954 p35 $103m obligated across projects, about $41m of supplies/equipment arrived, FY1954 target $85m adjusted from $130m; these are different accounting concepts
claims.conclusion: Separate approved programme, commitments, shipments, loans, cash contributions and actual project completion.

claims.statement: 1954-09-01 UNKRA 삼척 시멘트·비료·유리 공장 모두 완공·가동했다
contradicting_evidence: Yearbook p36: Samcheok cement plant being rehabilitated; new cement site chosen; fertilizer/flat-glass preliminary engineering completed; not all factories operational
claims.conclusion: Stage-specific planning vs work started vs equipment arrived vs operation; verify plant acceptance certificates.

claims.statement: 1954-09-01 UNKRA 주택 9500호와 학교개보수 예산 전액이 완료됐다
contradicting_evidence: Yearbook p37: 330 Seoul homes constructed, 148 under construction; 9000-9500 is programme plan; school supplies >$4.4m received, 7 university labs rebuilt, 33k books delivered
claims.conclusion: Completed vs under construction vs plan vs material receipt must be disaggregated.

claims.statement: 1954년 6월 백두진 사임 후 변영태 총리 임명·국무원 인준은 하나의 즉시 사건이다
contradicting_evidence: UNCURK paras79-82 6/19 Paik resignation acceptance, 6/22 Assembly constitutional vote, 6/27 Pyun temporary PM appointment, initial cabinet failed, revised cabinet later confirmed
claims.conclusion: Separate president announcement, parliamentary procedural vote, PM appointment, cabinet confirmation. Individual secret ballots not inferred.
